title: Zakira.Conduit manifest
description: Manifest describing skill sources to mirror into one or more local target directories.

name.description: Unique entry identifier. Optional: when omitted, Conduit derives a default from the source (GitHub/AzDO repo name, local directory basename, etc.), or uses the alias supplied via the in-string '... -> Name' shorthand or the { 'source': ..., 'as': 'Name' } wrapper. Used as the destination sub-directory name when the source produces exactly one content unit AND the chosen strategy honours per-entry naming (wrap); other strategies (flat, expand, skills) compute destination names from their own rules.

strategy.description: Strategy that controls the destination layout inside each target. 'wrap' (default) places content in <target>/<name>/, 'flat' merges content into <target>/, 'expand' lifts each top-level child of the source to <target>/<child>/, and 'skills' discovers SKILL.md folders and fans them out across detected agent harnesses under each target.

groupBy.description: When set to 'source', each entry's planned destinations are wrapped in an extra sub-directory named after the source (repo name / local basename / explicit alias). Useful when several entries share a target and you want each source's contributions kept together.

onCollision.description: Per-entry override for the collision policy applied when two planned destinations would write to the same path. Defaults to the manifest-global 'strategies.skills.onCollision' (for the skills strategy) or to 'error'.

skills.description: Skills-strategy filter: when set, only the listed skills (by SKILL.md folder basename, matching the frontmatter 'name:') are mirrored. Other discovered skills are silently skipped. Ignored for non-'skills' strategies.

harness.description: Skills-strategy filter for harness discovery under each target. true = require discovery (error when no registered harness matches); false = skip discovery and treat the target as a literal skills directory; array = enable discovery and restrict to the named harnesses (e.g. ['opencode', 'claude']). Ignored for non-'skills' strategies.

as.description: Renames the destination sub-directory for this entry/path. Honoured by the 'wrap' strategy; ignored by 'flat'/'expand'/'skills'.

strategies.description: Manifest-global strategy configuration. Every sub-section is optional.

harnessRegistry.description: Custom harness map merged with the built-in registry. Keys are harness names (the leading '.' is optional). Values are a single search path string, an array of search-path strings, or null to remove the built-in entry of that name. Built-in harnesses: opencode ('.opencode/skills', '.config/opencode/skills'), claude ('.claude/skills'), codex ('.codex/skills'), agents ('.agents/skills').

onCollision.description: Manifest-wide default collision policy for the skills strategy. Per-entry 'onCollision' overrides this.

sourceShorthand.description: Bare-URI shorthand. Equivalent to { "type": "uri", "uri": "<value>" }. May optionally suffix the URI with ' -> Name' to set the destination alias (e.g. "https://github.com/owner/repo -> MyName"); the alias must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$. The same strict URI prefix rules (./, ../, /, ~, $, %, drive letters, full URLs) apply to the URI portion. Bare slugs (owner/repo) are rejected; use the explicit object form for those.

aliasedSource.description: Wrapper that pairs any inner source (bare-URI shorthand, concrete source object, or nested wrapper-free shape) with an explicit destination alias. Equivalent to the in-string '... -> Name' shorthand but works for inner sources that are full objects, not just bare strings.

as.description: Destination alias. Becomes the owning entry's name when no 'name' is set on the entry, and (for array elements) the per-element name.

sourceArray.description: Array of sources. Each element is either a bare-string URI (optionally with ' -> Name' alias suffix), a wrapper object ({ 'source': ..., 'as': 'Name' }), or a full source object. The entry is expanded at load time into one independent sub-entry per element. Per-target 'as' aliases are not allowed on entries declared this way.

repo.description: Repository identifier. Accepts a slug (owner/repo), a github.com URL, or an SSH-style reference (git@github.com:owner/repo[.git]).

path.description: Optional single sub-path. Mutually exclusive with 'paths'.

paths.description: Optional list of sub-paths. Mutually exclusive with 'path'. With one element the destination subdirectory uses the entry name; with two or more, each sub-path mirrors to its basename (or 'as' alias) and the entry name is metadata only.

branch.description: Branch (or tag) name. May coexist with 'commit': in that case 'branch' is the tracking intent and 'commit' is the locked-in snapshot. `conduit pin` and `conduit update` rewrite 'commit' to the latest SHA on this branch.

commit.description: Commit SHA. When both 'branch' and 'commit' are present, 'commit' wins for fetching; 'branch' is retained as the refresh intent.

auth.description: Auth chain for github. Default when omitted: [env, gh, anonymous].

patEnv.description: Env var name to read a PAT from when using the 'pat' auth mode. Defaults to CONDUIT_GITHUB_TOKEN.

path.description: Single source directory. Mutually exclusive with 'paths'.

paths.description: Multiple source directories. Mutually exclusive with 'path'.

url.description: Browser-paste / git remote URL. Mutually exclusive with the explicit ('organization','project','repo') triplet.

organization.description: Azure DevOps organization (cloud) or collection (Server) name.

baseUrl.description: Base URL override for self-hosted AzDO Server. Defaults to https://dev.azure.com/ when using the triplet form.

path.description: Optional single sub-path inside the repository. Mutually exclusive with 'paths'.

auth.description: Auth chain. Default when omitted: [env, az].

patEnv.description: Env var name to read a PAT from when using the 'pat' auth mode. Defaults to CONDUIT_AZDO_TOKEN.

uriSource.description: Source whose concrete kind (github, azdo, local, ...) is inferred from the 'uri' value at load time. Useful when copy-pasting browse URLs without remembering which 'type' to set.

uri.description: The source URI. Either a full URL (https://github.com/..., https://dev.azure.com/.../_git/..., git@host:..., etc.) or a local-path-shaped value (./foo, ../foo, /abs, ~/foo, $VAR/foo, %VAR%/foo, C:\foo). Bare slugs (owner/repo) are intentionally NOT supported by inference; use 'type: github' for those.

path.description: Optional sub-path inside the source. Applies to remote sources only.

baseUrl.description: Forwarded to source kinds that support it (currently: azdo).

auth.description: Forwarded to source kinds that support it (currently: azdo).

globPatterns.description: List of file-relative glob patterns (Microsoft.Extensions.FileSystemGlobbing dialect: '*', '**', '?', bracket classes). For 'include' an empty/omitted list means 'include everything'; for 'exclude' an empty/omitted list means 'exclude nothing'.
